sources.text: fermented paste of leftover cheese with spirit, kept in a pot; unverified

facts.v: Sheep's milk warmed to about 35 °C and set with a plant coagulant; the curd is pressed, crumbled into an earthenware pot (tupí) with a spirit and stirred for four or five days, then fermented at least two months
Very soft, creamy and spicy, like llenguat; made in the Pyrenean districts of Cerdanya, Alt Urgell and Pallars, Catalonia
